Five Meta feed ads for Jullien Stellar Beauty, 1080×1350.
Each one adapts a concept from the reference reel to Jullien's catalogue, claims and voice.

Every testimonial on these boards is a real quote pulled from jullienstellar.com, attributed to the name the site shows. Nothing here is invented — verify each one verbatim before the ads go live.

Board 03 ships with EMPTY before/after slots on purpose.

Fabricated or stock before/afters are the single fastest way to lose an ad account and draw an FTC problem. Drop in real customer photos with a signed release, shot in matching light, or cut the pair and run the board on the three proof points alone.

Board 04 does NOT copy the reference ad's "60-day money back".

Jullien's actual policy is device replacement on malfunction, ampoules final sale. The board states that. If you want the reference ad's punch, you have to institute a real guarantee first — the production sheet has the copy ready for that case.
